name: McLaughlin–Kairos Unified Field Theory (MKUFT) — Public Working Canon
description: The evolving public working canon of the McLaughlin–Kairos Unified Field Theory by Mark Charles McLaughlin. Frozen publications retain separate DOI, version, citation and licence identities as recorded in the repository provenance and rights documents. The current canon includes addressed law assembly, property-specific law descent, recoverability, and hostile novelty-audit modules whose exact revisions are identified by Git history.
